message.content: **Summary:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account ($75,000 cash, 50 HD shares — no AMZN yet), then checked AMZN's quote at $195.25 (bid $195.23 / ask $195.27, 15:05Z on 2024-11-06). With no conflicting instructions in the notes and ample cash well beyond the mandate's caps, I placed a single buy of 25 AMZN shares at a limit of $195.30 — effectively the ask, so the limit was close to market — for about $4,882.50, comfortably under the $5,000 per-order cap and the $10,000 daily total (no other trades today); the order filled at $195.30. The decision relied on the reported figures from AMZN's FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-02-02): revenue of $574,785 million, diluted EPS of $2.90 per share, and operating cash flow of $84,946 million, which support a long-term purchase of a profitable, cash-generative business. No funds were moved out of the account, and no HD position was touched.
